description: A Move package. With only id: its modules, functions and upgrade history. With module and function: how to call it, each parameter explained, with a TypeScript snippet. With window (24h, 7d or 30d): calls per day and per function, failures and top callers. Example: { id: "0x2", module: "coin", function: "split" }.
name: package_info
title: Read a Move package
